scope__system_components_included.quote: "HVACR" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment in heating and air conditioning
"HVACR" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment in heating and air conditioning
installing six feet (6') or less final of gas piping connection to a heating unit from an existing, accessible manual safety shutoff gas cock
Class D - Entitles the licensee to perform sheet metal work as it relates to ductwork for HVACR systems
"Refrigeration" means the use of mechanical or absorption equipment to control temperature or humidity
Factory assembled air-cooled, self-contained refrigeration equipment of one and one-half horsepower (1.5 h.p.) or less and which have no refrigerant lines extending beyond the cabinet enclosure
Factory assembled air-cooled, self-contained refrigeration equipment of one and one-half horsepower (1.5 h.p.) or less
Factory assembled air-cooled, self-contained, window-type air conditioning units of thirty-six thousand (36,000) BTUH or less not connected to ducts
the replacement or repair of a liquefied petroleum gas central heating unit when it is combined with an air conditioning unit
Engaged in the installation, repair, or replacement of a liquefied petroleum gas appliance
"HVACR gas fitting work" means gas fitting work for the purpose of supplying an HVACR system and shall be limited to installing six feet (6') or less final of gas piping connection to a heating unit
installing six feet (6') or less final of gas piping connection to a heating unit from an existing, accessible manual safety shutoff gas cock
installing flue gas vents and combustion air for the HVACR system
installing flue gas vents and combustion air for the HVACR system
"Ventilation" means the process of supplying or removing air by natural or mechanical means to or from any space.

"HVACR" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment in heating and air conditioning, refrigeration, ventilation, or process cooling or heating systems
Any individual licensed or registered to perform HVACR work may perform electrical connections to heating and air conditioning units without obtaining any other license to perform the work
"Heating and air conditioning" means the process of treating air to control temperature, humidity, cleanliness, ventilation, or circulation to meet human comfort requirements
